blocks.x: Architecture, security posture and audit evidence for Achala Ledger — distributed trust & tokenization platform from Achala IT Solutions.

The platform separates three planes. The data plane carries workload (permissioned DLT with bank-grade operations, membership, visibility zones, legal wrapper, compliance-aware issuance and transfer controls); the control plane carries policy and orchestration (specification-first, verified, audited contracts, custody anchoring with role-based verification); the evidence plane carries audit, replay and conformity documentation — the plane most vendors skip and every regulator asks about.

Ledger networks ship key management under HSM custody, timelocked upgrade governance, and immutable audit exports. Smart contracts carry specification, verification and independent audit before value moves; pause procedures are rehearsed, not improvised.

items: privacy model, audit exports, jurisdiction analysis
platform controls audited; evidence exports mapped to customer audit scopes.
DORA, HIPAA-ready pods, PCI DSS support and GDPR data-residency options where the estate requires them.
NIST AI RMF and ISO/IEC 42001 control mapping; EU AI Act documentation generated for high-risk deployments.

blocks.x: The control plane is sized for enterprise scale: decision and orchestration paths carry published latency budgets, and the evidence plane writes append-only logs that never sit on the hot path.

items: deployed inside your cloud landing zone; customer-managed keys; your SIEM receives telemetry.
operated by our pods under SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 with quarterly evidence exports.
Twinverse and Sentinel patterns extend to plant, store and site estates with signed boot and 62443-aligned segmentation.

blocks.x: Hyperledger Fabric/Besu, HSM fleets, W3C VC/DID, static/formal verification tools. Adapters to core systems (CRM, ERP, core banking, EHR, WMS/MES, SCADA) are versioned contracts — one schema change propagates to every consumer.
